sources.title: KOSIF Infinite Matrices v0.1.0 prototype package (owner's earlier SVG A/B engine)

sources.title: Lateral Thinking Course (Lateral Thinking Mind, 2014)
sources.rights: Copyrighted book; not redistributed, no text quoted
used_for: random-entry input -> ideate draws parents from a seeded random pool, not from similar names
challenge established concepts -> each recipe must name the assumption its counterfactual removes

sources.title: Smart Thinking: How to Think Conceptually, Design Solutions and Make Decisions (Bryan Greetham, Palgrave 2016)
sources.rights: Copyrighted book; not redistributed, no text quoted
used_for: conceptual analysis (a concept = its necessary characteristics) -> recipe validation demands all six bricks
synthesis of ideas -> one cross-role causal coupling instead of overlaying looks

sources.title: The Pragmatic Programmer (Hunt & Thomas)
sources.rights: Copyrighted book; not redistributed, no text quoted
used_for: tracer bullet: one thin end-to-end path recipe->engine->scene->render->ledger before breadth
DRY: the engine is the single source of numbers, the scene only plays them back
orthogonality: structure / dynamics / finish adapters change independently

sources.title: 'Probability Theory: the Logic of Science' testbank listing (not the book itself)
used_for: reminder to score feedback as probability: operator scores are Beta(1+wins,1+losses) posteriors (standard Bayesian practice, not taken from this file)
sources.note: The file's readable pages are a product listing, so no method was extracted from its content.

sources.title: KOSIF Infinite Matrices v0.2.0 causal studio (owner's typed causal-design laboratory)
used_for: four typed causal laws ported as scripts/kmx_laws.py (trajectory_memory, material_memory, elastic_memory, self_imprinting) with exact reproduction of the four demo receipts
the four demo recipes kept as recipes/laws/*.json with their receipt metrics and frame hashes
197 original mechanism atoms (12 axes) kept as data/197_mechanism_atoms.json
typed causal contract (input port -> output port, one edge switched off in the control)
sources.note: sha256 is a tree digest of the unzipped upload (282 files; sorted path + file sha256), the zip bytes were not available. Not taken: legacy_svg_engine.py (identical to v0.1.0), infinite_matrices.py generator (the repo's ideate already covers it), source_index_86.json (same 86 ids as data/86_style_research_database.json), demo SVG frames (regenerable byte for byte with kmx_laws.py run --render).
sources.content_in_repo: ported code (owner's work), 4 recipes, 197 atom labels; no SVG frames
